# JoinOrder Q7c — Canonical JoinOrder 7c

```{tags} reference, query-template, joinorder
```

> [JoinOrder](../../join-order.md) benchmark · [all JoinOrder queries](index.md)

Canonical JoinOrder SQL query 7c; generated DataFrame translation

## Representative SQL

Rendered in the benchmark's native SQL with default parameters (no dialect translation available).

```sql
SELECT
  MIN(n.name) AS cast_member_name,
  MIN(pi.info) AS cast_member_info
FROM aka_name AS an, cast_info AS ci, info_type AS it, link_type AS lt, movie_link AS ml, name AS n, person_info AS pi, title AS t
WHERE
  NOT an.name IS NULL
  AND (
    an.name LIKE '%a%' OR an.name LIKE 'A%'
  )
  AND it.info = 'mini biography'
  AND lt.link IN ('references', 'referenced in', 'features', 'featured in')
  AND n.name_pcode_cf BETWEEN 'A' AND 'F'
  AND (
    n.gender = 'm' OR (
      n.gender = 'f' AND n.name LIKE 'A%'
    )
  )
  AND NOT pi.note IS NULL
  AND t.production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
  AND n.id = an.person_id
  AND n.id = pi.person_id
  AND ci.person_id = n.id
  AND t.id = ci.movie_id
  AND ml.linked_movie_id = t.id
  AND lt.id = ml.link_type_id
  AND it.id = pi.info_type_id
  AND pi.person_id = an.person_id
  AND pi.person_id = ci.person_id
  AND an.person_id = ci.person_id
  AND ci.movie_id = ml.linked_movie_id
```
